notes.title: FALSE AWAKENING PATCH 1.2.0 IS NOW OUT!
notes.content:
The New major update is finally here!

Patch 1.2.0

in a few words with this patch we make a trade. You give quality, we give performance.

OPTIMIZATION
- Compressed and Down-scaled nearly all Textures in game for 4k and 8k to 1k and 2k Resolution Respectively.
- Optimized and reduced the Shadow Quality to look sometimes better and have better performance.
- Swapped, Removed or/and Modified random clutter for better performance in expense for quality.
- Optimized Foliage further for better Performance.

BUGS / GLITCHES FIXED
- fixed some random events not occurring.
- fixed the issue where a hidden event taking place while the conditions were not met, causing a Retro filter to Display randomly.
and many more.

UI / MENU CHANGES
- Removed the EXTREME option from all Graphics Settings in the Settings Menu.
- Removed the LOW settings for Shadows Quality in the Settings Menu.
- Refined some fonts in some menus

SOUNDS
- Fixed an Issue where some sounds stopped from playing Suddenly (MUSIC and Ambient sounds)

notes.title: New Patch Available - Patch Notes for 1.1.2
notes.content:
SOUND
- Fixed an issue where certain sounds were not affected by the Sound Settings in Options Menu
- Adjusted certain sounds to be either louder or quieter 

GRAPHICS
- Fixed an issue that when the graphics settings were changed without resetting the game it caused nanites to break and cause graphical issues like muddy textures misplaced materials on objects and similar issues


KNOWN ISSUES WE ARE CURRENTLY WORKING ON
- Optimization: We are still working on more optimization of the game in order for more people to be able to play the game.
- Certain Events not working properly: Blocking values missing or miss behaving
- Dialogues overlapping
- Some inventory items not showing properly or at all (happens some times)
- Fog is not displaying at all when you turn Shadows to Low in the Graphics Settings

And some few more we will address in the future.

NOTE: Some things that are happening in-game and might seem like bugs or glitches might not be bugs but intended game features, for Example: 

- Player not receiving damage
- Difficulty navigating at some places
- Dialogues continue playing when you leave the place where they take place
- Black Screen at the intro of the Game
And some more.

But, if you notice anything that it feels or looks like a bug, glitch or unintended gaming feature please report it in the Discussion Tab of the Steam Community Page of the Game.

Thanks everyone for the overwhelming support!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
OPTIMIZATIONS
- Tweaks to Shadows
- Tweaks to Lighting Settings
- Cleared Useless clutter (not visible to player area
- Tweaks to Post Process
- Changed Render Distance for Certain Objects
- Cleared some Foliage
- Tweaked the Quality of Certain Objects

\\\\\\\\\

ADDITIONALLY
We would STRONGLY advice everyone to lower the View Distance in the Game settings to LOW.

Visually you won't get a big difference, but it will hugely improve the Performance of the game.

Thank you everyone for the patience and the Feedback.

notes.title: False Awakening Demo - Major Patch 1.1.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
Whats new with patch 1.1.0


AUDIO
- Fixed some missing Dialogues

INTERFACE
- Fixed some Subtitles that were overlapping
- Renamed Smooth Camera to Motion Blur
- Changed the Fonts to a Typewriter Style
- Fixed an issue where incorrect meshes were showing for Lighter and Flashlight

OPTIMIZATION
- Removed Unnecessary Clutter (Trash) Outside of the map area
- Reduced Foliage outside of the Map Area (Play Area)
- Optimized Lighting and Shadows
- Tweaks to the Post Process Value, Removing the Exposure Effect (Screen Becoming Dark)

LEVEL AND SCRIPTS
- Fixed the issue where The Photograph (Key) got burned when you lit the torch
- Fixed an issue where the player gets stuck beneath clutter when crouching
- Fixed an issue that some Objects were unpickable
- Fixed an issue when the lighter showed up in the wrong place (second Lighter)

NEW ADDITIONS
- Outlines on Objects. Pickable Objects now get a Red Outline, making it easier to identify When an Object can be picked up.


We are working hard on Optimizing the game further, we will keep you up to date with more news soon!

notes.title: An Introduction to the game
notes.content:
🔍 [i][b][u]Greetings everyone!
[/u][/b][/i]
Welcome to "Lost Traces: Unsolved Cases - Prologue," your gateway to a gripping adventure into the mysterious and the unexplained. We're thrilled to have you on board as we embark on a thrilling journey through a world shrouded in enigma and suspense.

🌌 [i][u][b]An Atmospheric Adventure Awaits:
[/b][/u][/i]
Dive into the eerie atmosphere of an atmospheric horror adventure, where every shadow hides a secret, and every clue brings you closer to unraveling a story unlike any other. "Lost Traces" will challenge your wits, immerse you in a rich narrative, and keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish.

🔦 [i][u][b]Explore the Unknown:
[/b][/u][/i]
In this prologue, you'll step into the shoes of Adam and Evelyn Strom, Siblings with a mysterious past, as Adam returns home to find a reality distorted by time and memories. Your journey will be filled with twists, turns, and a deep sense of unease as you explore an abandoned house, uncovering hidden secrets, and piecing together the fragments of a chilling puzzle.

👻 [i][u][b]Atmospheric Horror Meets Classic Adventure:
[/b][/u][/i]
"Lost Traces" is more than a game; it's an experience. Immerse yourself in a world where the line between reality and the supernatural blurs. Engage with a classic horror adventure interface that emphasizes story-driven gameplay, intricate puzzles, and a carefully crafted atmosphere that will linger with you even after you've put down the game.

🌟 [i][u][b]What to Expect:
[/b][/u][/i]
 -   A compelling narrative that unfolds with every step.
 -   Stunning visuals and a meticulously designed environment.
 -   mechanics reminiscent of that of Old-school point-and-click with a modern twist.
 -   Atmospheric horror that keeps you guessing till the end.

🚪 [i][u][b]Are You Ready to Open the Door to the Unknown?
[/b][/u][/i]
"Lost Traces: Unsolved Cases - Prologue" is more than a game; it's an invitation to a world where reality and mystery collide. Get ready to lose yourself in an adventure that will leave you questioning the very fabric of existence.


~We hope you believe in conspiracy theories, because you will be living in one~

🕯️ Lost Traces Development Team 🕯️
